The page seems to load more content as you scroll, and the recording could not show all of it; content after the feed was reached only by Shift+Tab from the end.

Criteria.TestCondition: The focus order preserves the meaning and operability of the web page.
Criteria.TesterComment:
Keyboard focus moves through parts of the page in an order that doesn't make sense, which can confuse keyboard and screen reader users. The focus order doesn't make sense here: focus goes from "Scroll down" (button) back to "OVERVIEW" (tab), which comes earlier in the page; focus jumps back up the page from "View timeline" (button) to "name" (textbox); focus jumps back up the page from "birth year" (spinbutton) to "#radix-\:r0\: > div:nth-of-type(2) > div:nth-of..." (checkbox); focus moves backward along a line from "#radix-\:r0\: > div:nth-of-type(2) > div:nth-of..." (button) to "#addEntryContainer > button" (button); focus jumps back up the page from "Scroll down" (button) to "OVERVIEW" (tab). Focus starts at View timeline button (1), then jumps to form rows on the right (2-22), then Scroll down (23), then back up to the tabs (24-27). Tabs and overview come last, so the order jumps around the page.. If you disagree, tell your assistant. The Tab walk did not get through the whole page, so the order past that point is unknown.
